job.job_description:
Advanced proficiency in Python and strong software engineering foundations, including object-oriented design, data structures, algorithms, testing, version control, and design patterns.
Generative AI: LLMs, RAG, prompt engineering, fine-tuning, agents, evaluation frameworks, guardrails, and responsible AI.
Strong hands-on experience with machine learning and deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or scikit-learn.
Practical experience building applications with large language models and related frameworks, orchestration tools, embedding models, and vector search technologies.
Experience deploying AI workloads on at least one major cloud platform-preferably Microsoft Azure-or equivalent experience with AWS or Google Cloud.
Strong knowledge of containerization, Kubernetes, CI/CD, REST APIs, microservices, distributed systems, and infrastructure-as-code practices.
Demonstrated experience with model deployment, monitoring, optimization, governance, and production support.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, stakeholder-management, and technical leadership skills.
